01-title-mode-menu.verdict: A competent dark-and-amber palette with a clear primary button, but the screen is a cluttered web-form stack of lore, tutorial cards, key hints, seven mode buttons, and save admin, with no real hero and many tiny, low-contrast elements.

02-welcome-pack.verdict: A full-screen dark slab with a tiny left-hugging list, a wall of explaining text and a huge dead void; it reads as a debug dump rather than a welcome reward moment, with no hierarchy and no celebration.
